theme_overview.vibe: High-end 2026 Agricultural SaaS, industrial command center with phone-first PWA polish ('Broiler Base Mate' family)
theme_overview.emotional_tone: Command-center precision on desktop; tactical, warm, high-contrast field efficiency on phone
theme_overview.theme_preference: Dark-first with phone-optimized native browser chrome integration

phone_browser_chrome_strategy.problem_analysis: Founder Jason's 'boring chrome' feedback stems from default white/navy browser bars, mismatched theme-color tags vs manifests, missing iOS Apple PWA tags, and zero splash screens on the Mort Buddy QR page, making mobile pages feel like plain Web 1.0 tabs.
phone_browser_chrome_strategy.phone_visual_identity: Tactical Field Green & Dark Slate ('Bio-Luminescent Farm Tech'). A phone-first evolution of BBM's desktop navy/gold that bridges agricultural warmth with high-visibility field UI.

pwa_splash_screen_design.reader_splash: Dark Emerald background (#0B1911) with a central glowing SVG emblem (Silo + AI Eye) with subtle bio-mesh radial background pulse and text 'BROILER BASE MATE • READER v2.6'.
pwa_splash_screen_design.mort_buddy_splash: Deep Slate-Navy background (#0A1118) with a high-visibility tactical emblem (Shield + Rooster Silhouette) with quick QR badge and text 'BBM MORT BUDDY • SHED DIRECT'.

headings.usage_rules: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit for a modern tech feel with tight tracking on H1/H2.

body.usage_rules: Optimal for dense data grids and dashboards. Use for all feed grid numerics, body text, and labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10' for the Right Silo Panel and Top Header. Ensures data doesn't feel flat.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on elevated surfaces (border-white/5 to border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-2xl shadow-black/50) for modal elements and dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle tactical noise/grain overlay (opacity-5) on the main app wrapper to kill 'digital flatness'.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid or Flex layout. Left Sidebar (fixed 240px, collapses on mobile). Main Content (fluid). Right Silo Panel (320px fixed on desktop, bottom drawer or collapsed on <1280px).
layouts.header: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur glass effect. Contains breadcrumbs, theme toggle, and profile.
layouts.flock_forecast_grid: Bento-style High Density Grid for KPIs. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3. Gap: gap-4. Utilize h-full for stretching.
layouts.feed_program_grid: Full-width complex table. Sticky first column (Day/Date) and sticky table header. Horizontal and vertical scrolling enabled.

components.silo_gauge: Semi-circle gauge chart (via Recharts or SVG). Must be animated on load to fill up to the current total capacity percentage. Colored arcs for Critical (Red), Low (Amber), OK (Green).
components.kpi_tiles: Flat solid background or glass effect, 1px border. Value text should use Outfit text-4xl font-semibold. Subtle icon in top-right with brand-muted background.
components.feed_grid_table: Dense cells. Use rich color-coded status pips (small rounded indicators 8px by 8px or subtle background tints). Today's row gets a distinct highlight (e.g., border-l-2 border-primary bg-primary/5).
components.sliders: Customized Shadcn Slider for 'Catch Day' and 'Target Weight'. Accent color matches primary green.
components.charts: Recharts. Dark theme grids (stroke='#272B36'). Actual data = solid line. Forecast data = dashed line. Tooltips must have dark glassmorphism background.

motion.hero_moment: On initial app load, trigger a staggered Framer Motion entrance for the main Feed grid rows or Forecast KPI tiles (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.05).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons get a subtle scale-down on tap (scale: 0.98). Table rows get a very subtle bg-white/5 on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against status colors meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, and form inputs MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-batch-btn').

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all UI icons. Keep stroke-width consistent (usually 1.5 or 2).
media.charts_library: Use Recharts for the Silo gauge, Weight Growth Curve, and Daily Feed Usage Forecast.

avatar_placeholder.description: Elderly Australian farmer portrait for the user profile avatar in the header.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Mobile Chrome & PWA Foundation
phased_implementation_plan.description: Align theme-color meta tags, manifest files, and Apple iOS PWA tags for both Reader app (#0B1911) and Mort Buddy QR page (#0A1118). Add splash screen components and standalone PWA launcher polish.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Desktop Shell & Feed Program
phased_implementation_plan.description: Establish the 2026 dark theme tokens. Build the layout shell, sticky header, feed grid table, and animated Silo gauge panel.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Flock Forecast View
phased_implementation_plan.description: Build the interactive Flock Forecast page with Recharts growth curves, parameter sliders, and bento KPI tiles.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Treat all files as .js/.jsx. The project uses standard JavaScript/JSX, not TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure both mobile surfaces (Reader app and Mort Buddy QR page) have unified theme-color meta tags matching their respective manifests.
Implement apple-mobile-web-app-capable and apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style tags on all mobile pages.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all actionable elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
Never use generic placeholder image URLs.
